# Test fixtures — FICTIONAL

The 11 judgments here are invented (parties, citations and holdings), written so the pipeline can be
tested end to end without downloading anything. They are not law and must not be cited.
`make_fixture.py` turns them into miniature versions of every input the pipeline expects:
a Bhattacharya-format zip, an AILA-format zip, and SC-style judgments with metadata.
